description.value:
Twi'leks are a humanoid species distinguished by their pair of long, tapering head-tails, called lekku, which serve both as sensory organs and as a secondary means of nonverbal communication. Native to the arid world of Ryloth, Twi'leks have spread throughout the galaxy in vast numbers, prized — and too often exploited — for their striking appearance and adaptability.

Despite a history of hardship under slavers and occupying powers, Twi'lek culture is resilient and diverse, producing everything from shrewd merchants and dancers to soldiers, senators, and Jedi.

traits.name: Lekku Sense
traits.description: Your lekku pick up subtle air currents and vibrations. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or touch.

traits.name: Cultural Adaptability
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice, reflecting a lifetime navigating diverse and often hostile galactic cultures.

traits.name: Desert Hardiness
traits.description: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to resist the effects of extreme heat and exhaustion from lack of water.
